## E — Market signal: pedestrian rules, turns, red-light penalties, emergency vehicles, funerals and school buses
Market research was not performed in this state worker pass and no CompetitiveIntel artifact was supplied, so the market pack for this topic is typed debt (AZ-YIELD-E-MARKET).
Open items: applicant volume, pass rates, seasonality, buyer persona, price expectations, verbatim voice-of-customer quotes, ad hooks and the named gap.
Manual-only observation, not market evidence: the fire and police following distances, the red-light penalty amounts and the divided-roadway school-bus exception are easy to confuse, so learners may value a short yield and emergency-vehicle drill.
No market figures are asserted; every figure waits for a sourced recon pass.
